findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "norric_search_v1" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the Norric monitored universe by organisation number prefix or company name prefix. Returns each match with its current risk score / band / tier when ava…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "norric_watch_create_v1" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create a Norric Watch: push a signed webhook to callback_url when a watched company's Kreditvakt data changes. Args: event_types: one or more of: company.risk_t…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: norric_watch_update_v1 · Private data: signal_score_municipality_v1, signal_weekly_call_list_v1, kreditvakt_score_company_v1, norric_explain_score_v1, norric_data_freshness_v1, norric_watch_list_v1 · Public sink: siteloop_submit_lead_v1, norric_watch_create_v1 · Destructive: kreditvakt_contagion_v1, norric_watch_delete_v1.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: norric_watch_update_v1 · Private data: signal_score_municipality_v1, signal_weekly_call_list_v1, kreditvakt_score_company_v1, norric_explain_score_v1, norric_data_freshness_v1, norric_watch_list_v1 · Public sink: siteloop_submit_lead_v1, norric_watch_create_v1 · Destructive: kreditvakt_contagion_v1, norric_watch_delete_v1

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
